annotation.title_clean: 総務省所管補助金等交付規則
annotation.title_en: Ordinance on the Grant of Subsidies etc. under the Jurisdiction of the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 総務省 (Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications), Japan
annotation.summary_en: Japanese ministerial ordinance (2000, amended through June 2026) setting procedures for subsidies administered by the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications: conditions, application withdrawal deadlines, progress and performance reports, and an appendix of asset-disposal restriction periods. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Subsidy grant conditions set by the Minister of Internal Affairs and Communications
Applications can be withdrawn within 20 days of grant notification
Performance reports are due within one month of project completion
Appendix sets disposal restriction periods for subsidized assets
Latest amendment is Ministry Ordinance No. 79 of 2026
